title: Snake Classic
description: The timeless Nokia & arcade classic. Eat the apples, grow your tail, and avoid crashing into walls or yourself.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate

title: Tetris Block Master
description: Stack, rotate, and clear lines in this authentic arcade edition with ghost pieces, hard drops, and progressive levels.
controls: Left/Right Arrow or A/D to move
Down Arrow / S to soft drop

title: Retro Pong AI & 2P
description: The grandfather of video games. Challenge the adaptive AI bot or play with a friend in fast local multiplayer.

title: 2048 Number Fusion
description: Slide matching numbered tiles to fuse them into 2048 and beyond. Smooth animations with undo support and top score tracker.
controls: Arrow Keys or Swipe to slide

title: Flappy Pixel Bird
description: Flap your wings through narrow emerald pipe gaps. One tap is easy, surviving fifty is legendary.
controls: Spacebar or Left-Click or Tap to flap

title: Space Invaders 1978
description: Defend the earth against rows of descending alien invaders, hide behind defensive shields, and blast the bonus mothership.
controls: Left/Right Arrow or A/D to move

title: Neon Brick Breaker
description: Demolish vibrant neon brick walls with high-velocity bouncing spheres, power rebounds, and dynamic angle deflectors.

title: Minesweeper Pro
description: Clear the grid without detonating hidden explosives. Flag suspect squares, uncover clue numbers, and beat the clock.

title: Dino Desert Sprint
description: The famous offline dinosaur runner! Leap over desert cacti, duck under flying pterodactyls, and sprint through accelerating speeds.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump

title: Connect 4 Grid
description: Drop discs into the 7x6 suspended grid. Align 4 of your discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally against smart AI.
controls: Click any column to drop disc

title: Asteroids Vector Defense
description: Command your triangular spacecraft inside an asteroid field. Rotate, thrust with inertia physics, and blast space rocks into dust.
